SELECT 'abn' p, metric, service_name, count(*) n, round(avg(value),2) v FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE service_name='ts-inside-payment-service' GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', metric, service_name, count(*), round(avg(value),2) FROM normal_metrics WHERE service_name='ts-inside-payment-service' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,1

content.text: Inside-payment's container CPU rose from 0.05 to 0.38, but that is its own side effect. One last check: confirm across traces that the dashboard's failing calls are the parent of inside-payment's 500 responses.

input.query: SELECT c.service_name caller, s.service_name callee, s.span_name, s.attr_http_response_status_code code, count(*) n, round(avg(c.duration)/1e6,1) caller_ms, round(avg(s.duration)/1e6,1) callee_ms FROM abnormal_traces c JOIN abnormal_traces s ON s.trace_id=c.trace_id AND s.parent_span_id=c.span_id WHERE c.service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND s.service_name='ts-inside-payment-service' GROUP BY ALL
